name: tab-dedup
description: Deduplicate tabs in Zen Browser workspaces (and regular Firefox).

scripts.start: bun run build && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --browser-console --firefox-profile=./.dev-profile --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes
scripts.start:fresh: bun run build && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --browser-console
scripts.start:firefox: bun run build && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist --firefox-profile=./.dev-profile-firefox --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes
scripts.lint: bun run build && bunx web-ext lint --source-dir=dist
scripts.package: bun run build && bunx web-ext build --source-dir=dist --overwrite-dest
